basics.name: Jared McFarland
basics.label: Senior software engineer: zero-to-one products and tools for AI agents
basics.summary: A hands-on engineer who likes figuring out what to build as much as building it. Over eleven years at Mixpanel he has gone from customer support to mobile SDKs to AI products, most recently taking Mixpanel Headless from a solo experiment to a public launch. A lifelong experimental electronic musician.

work.name: Mixpanel
work.summary: Agent-native tools for analytics, and mobile Session Replay.
highlights: Created Mixpanel Headless, a Python SDK and CLI for developers and AI agents: started as a side project in December 2025, open sourced, and launched in public beta at MXP London on May 21, 2026.

Took mobile Session Replay from a solo prototype to general availability in 2025: built the iOS SDK in Swift to beta and wrote the Android SDK in Kotlin from scratch, then grew the effort into a staffed team.

work.name: Mixpanel
highlights: Full-stack billing, payments, and pricing, including the credits system behind Mixpanel for Startups.
SDKs on about ten platforms (iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, Unity, Python, Node, Ruby, PHP, Java), shipping feature flags and autocapture.
Data engineering on dbt and BigQuery.

work.name: Mixpanel
highlights: Mixpanel's first support engineer in Europe.
Built mixpanel-utils, a Python module that replaced a collection of internal scripts; released publicly and still used by customers and support engineers.

work.name: Advanced Service Technologies
work.summary: Nationwide retail point-of-sale installations and upgrades.
